description: Org policy records from fixed seeds (org root [0x51; 32], another key [0x52; 32], a peer [0x53; 32]), each as JSON text with the time it is verified at (skew 300) and the result: "ok" with the digest of its preimage, or the code. "cases" are served records (kind policy), read by both cores; "members_cases" are members records (kind policy-members), which never leave the org's edges and are read by the TypeScript core alone. Written by packages/core/test/policy.test.ts, read by crates/ac-core/src/policy/tests.rs.

cases.name: the minimal served record: no scopes, no external rules
valid 400 days after iat: it does not expire, a newer iat replaces it
external nulls and a non-ASCII <name>=* scope
a members record read as a served one
a deny list in a served record
an outbound section in a served record
a moderation section in a served record
a ttl, which no policy record has
a scope with a member added
a scope match that is empty
a type pattern with an inner star
a type pattern with an empty prefix
a required caveat that is the bare wildcard

members_cases.name: the minimal members record: every section null
a deny list, a refusal for the unknown, non-ASCII params
a served record read as a members one
roots.mode is neither allow nor deny
unknown allow: a policy never admits an unknown root
roots.list holds an IP literal domain
a module name with a capital
a moderation action that is not one
